verdict.rationale: Vanta's own GRC and PCI pages say you can cross-map controls across its pre-built frameworks, reuse controls, and automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort, and it lists SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA among its supported frameworks. That covers the core of work counting across frameworks. However, the evidence is only short marketing copy and never shows the overlap view, which keeps this at partial. missing for 10: documentation of a view showing the control/evidence overlap between frameworks, a specific SOC 2→ISO 27001/HIPAA mapping example, detail on how evidence credit is applied automatically, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown

citations.quote: you can cross-map your controls across [frameworks_count] pre-built frameworks (or ones you've customized)
Bring your existing program to Vanta and automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort
Automate evidence, reuse controls, and track progress all in one place.
SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and 35+ frameworks—automated and continuously monitored.
